newsitem.title: USA: Maine Yankee 910 MW nuke expected on line Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Maine Yankee 910 MW nuke expected on line Tuesday.

text.p: The Maine Yankee nuclear power plant in Wiscasset, Maine was likely to restart Tuesday morning and resume electricity production Wednesday, a spokeswoman for the plant said.
"If all goes according to schedule we will likely commence the startup process tomorrow, and it usually takes about a day before it synchronizes to the grid," the spokeswoman said Monday.
The plant was shut late Thursday for electrical repairs.
Maine Yankee is 38 percent owned by Central Maine Power Co, 20 percent each by New England Electric System and Northeast Utilities and 22 percent by other New England utilities.
